info.name: scala
info.category: Managed — JVM bytecode (also Scala Native, Scala.js)
info.typing: Statically and strongly typed; advanced type system (implicits, higher-kinded types)
info.design_notes: Scala targets the JVM and benefits from the same JIT, but functional patterns (boxing of value types into AnyRef, anonymous-class lambdas in older versions) can add overhead. Scala 3 and modern Scala libs lean on value classes and opaque types to recover performance.
key_traits: Heavier object churn unless code is allocation-aware
info.memory_baseline: JVM + extra allocation in functional patterns
